defect.problem: The page states good law/no negative treatment categorically, but the lake treatment derivation flags unresolved treatment-audit work and proposed negative events. Under the default-to-refuted rule, the treatment assertion cannot be verified from the disclosed record as framed.
defect.proposed_fix: Do not state 'No negative treatment' unless the proposed negative-treatment edges are resolved. Tighten to: 'Lake field_i_validity lists good_law as of 2026-06-30, but treatment derivation flags an audit needed for proposed negative events.'

reasons: The treatment field itself says field_i_validity is good_law and scope_note is 'Extends Vernonia to non-athletes; good law.'
But lane1_negative has cap_hit true, audit_needed true, and proposed_negative_events 6; lane2_top_cited also has cap_hit true, audit_needed true, and proposed_negative_events 24.
The disclosed record therefore does not let a sighted reviewer verify the stronger page statement 'No negative treatment' as of 2026-06-30.
residual_risks: The proposed edges all show field_iii as mentioned, so the good_law call may ultimately survive after audit; the defect is the unqualified treatment/no-negative-treatment presentation on an unresolved record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Qualify the treatment note with the unresolved audit status or remove the 'No negative treatment' sentence until the proposed negative events are resolved.
